text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I've done everything I could—from training 
to taking care of my condition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But if even this doesn't work...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I-I know that even without you 
telling me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... You're right. This is no time to 
lose heart...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, I'll run my own race. I 
definitely won't lose...!"
